collection.title: Class 10 Stream Selection Guidance Instrument
collection.description: 15-question psychometric instrument assessing Aptitude, Interest, and Work-Style for Class 10 students entering Class 11.
collection.scopeLabel: 15-Question Aptitude & Interest Assessment — Class 10 Stream Selection

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 1 of 15 (Aptitude): When faced with a complex numerical puzzle or physics formula derivation, how do you typically react?

options.text: I thrive on it! I love manipulating equations and finding precise logical solutions.
I prefer applying math to financial data, percentages, graphs, and business scenarios.
I prefer understanding biological systems, living organisms, and medical concepts over abstract math.
I prefer reading essays, analyzing history, debating social issues, or creative writing.

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 2 of 15 (Interest): What kind of documentaries or articles captivate your attention the most?

options.text: Space exploration, quantum mechanics, artificial intelligence, and robotics breakthroughs.
Human anatomy, medical discoveries, genetics, neuroscience, and wildlife conservation.
Stock market trends, startup founder stories, global trade, and economic policies.
World history, geopolitics, psychology, literature analysis, and social reforms.

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 3 of 15 (Work-Style): Which type of school assignment or project do you enjoy completing the most?

options.text: Building a working physics model, coding an app, or proving geometry theorems.
Dissecting plant specimens, drawing biological diagrams, or conducting chemistry titrations.
Creating a business plan, managing a budget, or auditing financial balance sheets.
Writing a detailed research paper, conducting surveys, or preparing for Model UN debates.

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 4 of 15 (Aptitude): How comfortable are you with abstract mathematical concepts (Calculus, Trigonometry, Vectors)?

options.text: Very comfortable! Mathematics is one of my strongest and most enjoyable subjects.
Moderately comfortable, but I prefer applied statistics over heavy calculus.
I can handle basic math, but I struggle with advanced abstract derivations.
I strongly dislike heavy math and prefer subjects focused on language, art, or social sciences.

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 5 of 15 (Interest): Imagine your ideal long-term career environment. Where do you picture yourself?

options.text: Engineering lab, tech firm, architecture firm, or research & development center.
Hospital, medical clinic, biotechnology lab, pharmacy, or veterinary facility.
Corporate boardroom, investment bank, accounting firm, or e-commerce startup.
Civil services office, law court, journalism media house, design studio, or university.

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 6 of 15 (Work-Style): What learning style suits you best when preparing for exams?

options.text: Solving numerical problems and practicing step-by-step formula applications.
Memorizing terminology, structural diagrams, flowcharts, and biological processes.
Understanding rules, formulas for accounting, market trends, and business case studies.
Reading long chapters, forming arguments, writing detailed answers, and critical analysis.

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 7 of 15 (Aptitude): How do you perform in subjects requiring argumentative writing, history dates, or civics laws?

options.text: Excellently! I express thoughts fluently and retain historical timelines effortlessly.
I perform well if it relates to economics, business regulations, or commerce laws.
I prefer science facts and medical terms over history or literature essays.
I prefer logical formulas and physics derivations over subjective writing.

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 8 of 15 (Interest): How interested are you in computer programming, software development, or engineering logic?

options.text: Extremely interested! I want to study Computer Science, AI, or Engineering.
I like tech tools, but I prefer bioinformatics, medical tech, or healthcare applications.
I am interested in fintech, data analytics, e-commerce platforms, or business IT.
I prefer digital media, design, psychology, animation, or content creation over coding.

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 9 of 15 (Work-Style): Which environment sounds most engaging for your practical lab work?

options.text: Physics lab verifying circuit laws, optics, and mechanics equations.
Biology lab observing microscopic slides, plant tissue, or animal anatomy.
Computer lab working on Excel spreadsheets, financial models, or business simulations.
Language lab, art studio, geography mapping room, or psychology survey center.

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 10 of 15 (Aptitude): How easily do you understand business news, money management, or profit/loss calculations?

options.text: Very easily! I naturally grasp financial concepts, profit margins, and economic trends.
I understand financial numbers if supported by strong mathematical models and statistics.
I understand social policy impacts on economy, but dislike pure bookkeeping.
I prefer focusing on pure natural sciences or medical research.

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 11 of 15 (Interest): Which national level competitive entrance exam aligns best with your target goals?

options.text: JEE Main / JEE Advanced / BITSAT (Engineering & Physical Sciences).
NEET UG / Nursing / Biotechnology Entrance (Medical & Life Sciences).
CA Foundation / CS / IPMAT / CLAT / CUET Commerce.
UPSC Civil Services / NIDA / NIFT / CLAT Law / CUET Arts & Humanities.

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 12 of 15 (Work-Style): When making key decisions, what influences your thinking the most?

options.text: Rigorous mathematical proof, logical consistency, and empirical evidence.
Observational evidence, biological impact, and human empathy/wellbeing.
Cost-benefit analysis, profitability, market efficiency, and risk calculation.
Ethical considerations, historical precedent, social justice, and human narrative.

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 13 of 15 (Aptitude): How is your ability to retain extensive factual details, botanical names, or medical terminology?

options.text: Excellent! I have strong memory retention for detailed factual information.
Good, but I prefer understanding underlying mathematical principles rather than memorizing.
I retain financial rules and tax regulations easily when applied to accounts.
I retain dates, philosophical concepts, and literary themes very well.

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 14 of 15 (Interest): Which school club or extracurricular activity would you actively lead?

options.text: Robotics Club, Astronomy Club, or Science Exhibition Team.
Eco Club, Health & Red Cross Society, or Biology Olympiad Circle.
Entrepreneurship Cell, Finance Club, or School Festhill Management Committee.
Debating Society, Editorial Board, Dramatics Club, or MUN Club.

items.subject: Career Guidance
items.body: Question 15 of 15 (Work-Style): How do you handle intense exam preparation workload?

options.text: I maintain focus by systematically solving numerical problems and practice papers.
I manage through disciplined study of vast biological diagrams and theory revisions.
I stay organized with structured timetables, spreadsheets, and business case revisions.
I focus through comprehensive reading, essay drafting, and group discussions.
